notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hey guys, sorry for the long hiatus! I know it's been quite a while since the last update but I still do genuinely want to create a great game for everyone. The main focus of this update is to address a lot of the feedback I've received up to this point, and create one big update that will hopefully improve the enjoyment for all players! This is the first game I have ever developed and it has been a huge learning experience for me, thank you to everyone who provided their input and have followed the game this whole time! It shows me that you actually like the game and want more, which makes me incredibly happy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083563/c443178eeef7e474ea3f1d76d5d17fa5f8a13722.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]INTRODUCING CHAPTER SELECT[/b][/h2]

The biggest addition to Update 0.3 is the inclusion of chapters, allowing players to experience all of the content in a more structured format. Offering three unique scenarios with different settings and fixed layouts, this new gamemode will allow newer players to get used to the gameplay before trying out the randomized mode, which is still available separately from the lobby screen. The most common piece of feedback I received was regarding the steep learning curve of the game, players found the randomized map confusing and wanted more direction when it came to the puzzles. Each chapter will provide players with an ingame map item that will help them navigate through the area, as well as written notes that explain the various puzzles found within that level. There are also notes that go into detail about the unique behaviour of stalker enemies, telling players about their triggers and how to avoid them. Puzzle solutions will still remain randomized to provide some variety, and enemies can be randomized by selecting the Nightmare difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083563/380c4251e2fd05c3905b9e03da1eaac2120bbd19.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW ENEMY TYPES[/b][/h2]

Each chapter introduces a new enemy type into the game, each with their own unique set of behaviours. For example, the Mutant has a cage around it's head that prevents headshots from doing damage, forcing players to aim for its body. This is the complete opposite to the Skeleton who has armor covering it's body, making players target their head. I'll be leaving the other new enemies as a surprise for players, so be sure to let me know what you think of them and feel free to let me know some other ideas for unique enemies that I could add. All the new enemy types are also available in the randomized mode, but you may not always get them since enemies are randomly selected. If you want a guaranteed way to encounter all of them make sure to play through all of the chapters. Also be sure to read the notes to learn about their behaviours, I've made changes to the Ghost that will make her a bit easier to avoid too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083563/78fd0c1ede9c751cf1f00edb468ea8f8ec9ef8c2.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]IN-GAME HINTS[/b][/h2]

In addition to providing players with a map and notes, I've also added a hint option that will outline the current objectives the player has in more specific detail. Unlike maps and notes, the hint option is also available in the randomized mode, this will assist players who prefer to have more direct directions. You can access this feature in the lobby menu when choosing a gamemode. Hints have no effect on rank so don't worry about using it, but I would also recommend attempting to play without it at first and using the ingame notes to help figure out puzzles instead. If you'd rather not read through the notes then go ahead and enable hints, I understand that not all players enjoy figuring them out. For players who just want to play the game without having to worry about restarting after dying, I even changed the Casual difficulty to allow infinite respawns. So I hope you guys have fun!

[h2][b]ADDITIONAL CHANGES[/b][/h2]

Honestly I've made so many changes and fixes to the game over the last year that I can't list or remember all of them, but here are some of the most notable ones that I can recall.

[list]
[*] New achievements.
[*] Added an option to disable camera wobble to prevent motion sickness.
[*] Server calls have been greatly reduced to prevent disconnecting.
[*] Server browser now displays the selected mode and difficulty.
[*] Levels will now display your best rank and the time it took to achieve.
[*] Game will now save your last selected map and difficulty and automatically set them next time a lobby is formed.
[*] Ragdolls of dead players will respawn if they clip through the map.
[*] Self revived players will now respawn at the starting area with all items intact.
[*] Fixed issue with current ammo count not matching between players.
[*] Compass puzzle will now notify players if they are on the wrong floor.
[*] Green and blue valve colours have been modified to be more distinct.
[*] Piano puzzle has been tweaked slightly to prevent any issues.
[*] Stage room has been modified to be more modular with other rooms.
[/list]

Really hope you guys enjoy the new update! I have another smaller update planned soon with a few things I wasn't able to finish in time for this one, including the long awaited melee option.

notes.title: Added discard system, public lobbies, and offline mode
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a discard system for getting rid of items that are no longer needed. For example, the king key can be discarded after opening all the king doors and the radio can be discarded after solving the puzzle.
[*] Added a singleplayer option that will allow the game to be played offline without an internet connection.
[*] Added the option to choose between starting a private and public lobby when hosting a game.
[*] Added a new menu for finding public lobbies that have available space and have not started yet.
[*] Added the ability for the host of a lobby to kick other players.
[*] Items will now be retrieved from players who disconnect midgame and store them into the item box.
[*] Ammo will now automatically split into stacks of 20 when storing it into the item box, allowing players to share ammo amongst one another.
[*] Made it so that a key will no longer spawn if there isn't any doors for it to open.
[*] Pause screen will now display the list of players in-game.
[*] Fusebox for the elevator will now be highlighted.
[*] Added new notification if test tube resets back to default when mixing chemicals.
[*] Added new notification for when wrong valve handle is used in the greenhouse.
[*] Made the colour of the blue valve more distinct to avoid confusion with the green valve.
[*] Fixed issues with French translation for ammunition not displaying the amount.
[/list]
I want to continue to work on adding more content to the game, but if you run into any issues with the latest update let me know and I'll make it my priority to fix it first. I have some cool ideas planned for this game which I'll posting more about in the near future!

notes.title: Added custom map sizes
notes.content:
Added the option for the host of a lobby to change the size of the map. This will allow newer players the chance to learn puzzles/game mechanics in a much smaller environment before delving into the full-scale manor. 

Since the large map is technically still the main game, most achievements are disabled for small and medium map sizes. Only 'Mastermind' and 'Runaway' will still be obtainable. This is only temporary as I do plan to add more achievements in the future.

The number of zombies and resources will also change depending on the size of the map:

[b]Small Map[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 Floor (Around 40 rooms)
[*] 30 Enemies (1 special enemy type)
[*] 3 Ammo boxes per weapon
[*] 4 Puzzles
[/list]
[b]Medium Map[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 Floors (Around 65 rooms)
[*] 40 Enemies (2 special enemy types)
[*] 4 Ammo boxes per weapon
[*] 8 Puzzles
[/list]
[b]Large Map[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 Floors (Around 80 rooms)
[*] 50 Enemies (3 special enemy types)
[*] 5 Ammo boxes per weapon
[*] 12 puzzles
[/list]
I also added an objective bar to the inventory screen that shows which escape route has spawned and the player's progress toward accessing it.

I'll be working on implementing a discard system, as well as a few other additions that were suggested. If you have any feedback always be sure to let me know in the Steam Discussions board, thanks!

notes.title: New Weapon: Flare Gun
notes.content:
[h3]Flare Gun[/h3]
This new weapon is unlike any other, and much more powerful than the rest. Using explosive ammunition you can instantly kill any enemy in the game with only a single shot, the blast radius of the explosion also allows you to down multiple enemies simultaneously. However, the biggest advantage of this new weapon that truly sets it apart from the rest is the ability to temporarily stun the ghost that lurks throughout the manor. This will disable her for 60 seconds before she respawns back at her cell. 

The flare gun is only available for Standard/Casual difficulty, you can find it inside the room marked with a skull on the door. Ammo for this weapon is extremely scarce, 10 rounds for Casual and 5 for Standard. It is up to player to decide on the most efficient way of utilizing these bullets. 

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
Added a few achievements to reward players who managed to beat the game, as well as a few other challenges. I plan to add more in the future, but for now the 10 achievements are as follows:

[list]
[*] [b]Resident: [/b]Finish the game on Casual difficulty or higher.
[*] [b]Escapee: [/b]Finish the game on Standard difficulty or higher.
[*] [b]Survivor: [/b]Finish the game on Hardcore difficulty or higher.
[*] [b]Champion: [/b]Finish the game on Nightmare difficulty.
[*] [b]Perfectionist: [/b]Achieve an S+ ranking on Nightmare difficulty.
[*] [b]Executioner: [/b]Kill all monsters in the manor.
[*] [b]Speedrunner: [/b]Beat the game in under 1 hour.
[*] [b]Untouchable: [/b]Beat the game without using heals or revives.
[*] [b]Mastermind: [/b]Complete all puzzles. (This requires multiple playthroughs as the puzzles are randomized)
[*] [b]Runaway: [/b]Escape using every route. (This requires multiple playthroughs as the escape route is randomized)
[/list]
[h3]Additional Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Instructions for the generator puzzle has now been translated for all languages.
[*] Hint above generator has been removed, it is now included in the instructions.
[*] Due to the addition of the flare gun, I've reset the speed of the ghost for Casual. 
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed collider in one of the rooms that made the keypad inaccessible.
[*] Fixed collider in one of the kitchen rooms where bullets couldn't pass through.
[*] Fixed collider for the staircases where bullets couldn't pass through.
[*] Fixed navmesh for the staircases that should prevent enemies from getting stuck.
[*] Fixed missing ceiling texture in the one of the corridors.
[*] Fixed inventory icon for rifle ammo being affected by quality settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h3]In-Depth Puzzles[/h3]
Redesigned the puzzles to make them more in-depth. Previously, solving puzzles would always reward players with an escape item. However in the newest update, puzzles can now reward players with items used to solve other puzzles in the manor. This makes the game much more similar to an escape room. Due to this change I've limited the number of escape routes back to 1 and had to add some extra steps to some of the puzzles:

[list]
[*] Firing range button is now missing, players will have to find and place the button themselves in order to activate the targets.
[*] Sequence puzzle will now spawn with a cover over it, players will have to find a screwdriver to remove said cover.
[*] Doll room will now be barricaded by wooden boards, players must look for a hammer to remove them.
[*] Generator room now requires an orange keycard to open.
[*] Bar room now requires a blue keycard to open.
[*] Card puzzle will now only spawn 3 of the 4 cards, players will have to figure out the last digit of the code themselves.
[/list]
[h3]Self-Revives[/h3]
Added self-revives, allowing players to automatically revive themselves when they die with a cross in their inventory. I added this as a way to make the game easier for people playing solo, although it does work for multiplayer too. If you self-revive, you get to keep all the items in your inventory, otherwise all of your items will be sent to the storage box. (Only available for Standard and Casual).

[h3]Additional changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Ghost to Casual mode, but at a much slower speed and deals less damage.
[*] Added warning for when players on different versions try to connect to each other. This will only work for version 0.2.1 and above.
[*] Added warning for when players fail to connect to the Steam Network.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed curtains disappearing after solving the piano puzzle.
[*] Fixed painting puzzle occasionally spawning the wrong item.
[*] Fixed gate for the boat escape clipping through the ground when spawning on the bottom floor.
[*] Fixed some of the item descriptions not displaying for players with unmodified settings files.
[*] Fixed collision for one of the chairs in the surveillance room.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
The newest update of Enigma Manor is here and completely changes the way the game is played. The size of the manor has been expanded, now consisting of multiple floors. The map will now include 12 puzzles rather than 4, as well as multiple escape routes. This will allow players to experience much more of the content that's included in the game without having to replay the game too many times. Based on feedback I've also added revives for multiplayer and made lots of improvements to optimization.

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 20 new rooms to the manor, greatly increasing the map size.
[*] Added revives for multiplayer (only available for Standard and Casual mode), you will need to find a cross to use on a player's tombstone, However, just like other resources these are limited.
[*] Added 2 more storage boxes to the map due to the much larger size, these are evenly spaced out to allow for easier access.
[*] The manor now consists of three different floors.
[*] Map will now include 12 puzzles and all 3 escape routes.
[*] Put a warning for players who have their resolution set to high.
[*] Removed SteamAudio from the game as it was having a big impact on performance.
[*] Game Over screen will now display stats, just like the Results screen.
[*] Players will now take less damage on Casual mode.
[*] Enemies on Hardcore and Nightmare will now do increased damage again.
[*] Hardcore and Nightmare mode will now spawn less resources, which includes less weapons, ammo, and heals.
[*] Ghost is now more transparent and will spawn after 60 seconds for Nightmare mode. 
[*] Syringes will now heal 100% of player's health rather than 50%.
[*] Half of the enemies will now spawn in unlocked rooms.
[*] Doll puzzle timer is now set to 3 minutes rather than 1 minute.
[*] Radios for the Morse Code and Piano puzzle will no longer play audio unless examined.
[*] Reduced the audio range for most of the sound effects.
[*] Fixed bug where players could interact with objects as they were dying.
[*] Fixed bug where resurrected players were not able to use items.
[*] Fixed issue with the game over and result screen being off center for certain resolutions.
[/list]

Hope you guys enjoy the new update! As always, if you have any feedback or suggestions of things you would like to see added please let me know in the Steam Discussions board. Thanks.

notes.title: 0.1.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
Based on user feedback, I've made some more changes in regards to the difficulty of the game.

[list]
[*] For Casual and Standard mode, the majority of enemies will now spawn in locked rooms. This means that there will be less zombies around at the start of the game, which should allow players more time to explore and gather resources without immediately dying.
[*] For Casual mode, enemy health has been reduced by 50% and more heals will spawn around the map. Due to these changes, I've decided to return the enemy count for this difficulty back to 50.
[*] For the players who preferred the challenge of the original version, Hardcore and Nightmare mode have remained the same. However, enemies in these difficulties will no longer do increased damage and will use their base damage values instead.
[*] [spoiler]The ghost will now deal 50% damage to players for ALL difficulties, including Hardcore and Nightmare. This gives players a second chance incase they run into a dead end while being chased.[/spoiler]
[*] Added two new corridors to the map to allow more locked rooms to spawn.
[*] Temporarily removed the math puzzle while I work on redesigning it.
[*] Fixed an invincible spot in the storage room where enemies couldn't attack the player.
[/list]
For those who want to play the game with a revive feature, you can access it for now by switching to the public beta version. Right click on the game in your Steam library and select (Properties... >  Betas > public_beta).  There are currently a few issues with it that I want to resolve before releasing to the main game, but for those who wanted to try it out early I've made it available.

As always, if you have any feedback on the current version of the game or suggestions of things you would like to see added please let me know in the Steam Discussions board. Thanks!

notes.title: 0.1.0b Added Difficulty Modes
notes.content:
Added new difficulty modes that allows players to customize their experience:

[b]Casual[/b]
- Less zombies
- 1 special enemy type
- Ghost is not active

[b]Standard[/b]
- 1 special enemy type
- Ghost is active

[b]Hardcore[/b]
- Multiple special enemy types
- Ghost is active

[b]Nightmare[/b]
- Multiple special enemy types
- Special enemies can spawn anywhere
- Ghost is active

Additional updates:
[list]
[*] Ghost speed is slower and chase distance is also reduced, to make the game more forgiving.
[*] Final results screen will now display which difficulty the game was completed on.
[*] Fixed an invincible spot in one of the closets where enemies couldn't attack player.
[*] Highlighted the item box to be more noticable to new players.
[/list]
